steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the project title required by the case.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB product and set its quantity to 10.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Use the product mapping to add every vendor available through the product's Invite Vendor action.

args.text: Invite N more participant based on the products

steps.note: Verify that the product-based invitation prompt disappears after all mapped vendors are added.
Commit the default 30-minute schedule before publishing.
Confirm that publishing reached the real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants tab.
Confirm that the published stage has invited participants.
